name: Upstash Redis
solves: Provides an HTTP/REST-based Redis client that works in serverless and edge environments where persistent TCP connections are unavailable, enabling caching, session storage, and data operations via Upstash's managed Redis service.
best_for: Caching and key-value storage in serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Vercel Serverless Functions) where TCP-based Redis clients cannot maintain connections
Edge runtime caching with Cloudflare Workers or Vercel Edge Functions that forbid raw TCP sockets
Next.js applications needing distributed caching or rate limiting without managing Redis infrastructure
Lightweight session or state storage in Jamstack or statically-deployed apps that communicate over HTTP
Multi-region, low-latency caching via Upstash's globally replicated Redis without connection pooling overhead
skip_when: You need a self-hosted or on-premise Redis setup — this client only works with the Upstash managed REST API
Your workload requires high-throughput pipelining over persistent TCP connections where latency per command matters (use ioredis or node-redis instead)
You need advanced Redis features like Lua scripting debugging, Redis Modules, or cluster-mode topology control not exposed through the REST API
You want a provider-agnostic caching abstraction that can swap between Redis, Memcached, or in-memory backends (use keyv or unstorage instead)
Your application runs in a long-lived server process with stable networking where HTTP overhead per Redis call is unnecessary
